Sem artigo (∅):
- plural e incontáveis **em geral**: *∅ Dogs are loyal. · ∅ Coffee keeps me awake.*
- a maioria dos países, cidades, ruas, idiomas, nomes: *∅ France, ∅ Dublin, ∅ Oxford Street, ∅ English*
- refeições: *have ∅ breakfast · ∅ Lunch is ready.*
- expressões fixas: *go to ∅ work / school / bed, at ∅ home, by ∅ bus, on ∅ foot, in ∅ hospital*
- *next / last / this* + tempo: *∅ next week, ∅ last year*
- esportes e matérias escolares: *play ∅ tennis, study ∅ maths*
